text:
linda-cs: Noticing a spike in 'at-risk' flags this morning; playbook wf_renewal_engage is triggering for ~40 accounts that had no activity in 6+ months. Suspect healthscore change deployed last night.

miranda-data: Yep, I pushed a recalibration to the healthscore model at 02:10am UTC (")window_decay" param lowered from 180d -> 30d) to make scores more responsive. I didn't expect it to reclassify long-dormant accounts as high-risk immediately. Sorry for the churn.

sanjay-ops: That explains it. wf_renewal_engage uses health_status = 'at_risk' AND last_touch < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'. So lowering window made stale-but-unchanged accounts cross the threshold.

kevin-plat: Quick mitigation: put a temporary feature-flag on the recalibration and revert scoring to previous params while we validate. Also add a safety: playbooks should require a second signal (recent_telemetry > 0) before auto-firing for renewals.

linda-cs: Agreed. Can we pause wf_renewal_engage for 1h to stop more notifications to AEs and customers? I'll notify AEs.

ops-bot: Created incident INC-8721: "healthscore recalibration causing premature at-risk classification". Pager duty notified. (tools:deploy-bot)

miranda-data: Rolling back to previous param: window_decay = 180d. Will push in 15m. Also preparing a diff and unit tests to cover extreme parameter shifts.

sanjay-ops: While rollback runs, I'll add a gating rule to the playbook trigger:
```
-- require both at_risk AND (last_activity > NOW() - INTERVAL '180 days')
```
That will prevent classifying accounts with zero activity in 6+ months.

kevin-plat: Good. Also add a one-off backfill to mark accounts that got erroneously queued and remove pending tasks. Make a list for AEs so they can ignore duplicates.

linda-cs: I'll assemble the impacted account list and send to AEs + CS ops. Also toggling the feature flag off now.

ops-bot: INC-8721 updated: rollback complete, playbook paused, monitoring for reclassifications (10m window). Backfill task created: CS-8730.

miranda-data: Post-mortem item: add a preflight sim that runs recalibration on a holdout slice and reports delta counts for at-risk buckets before merge. I'll open PR for that workflow.

sanjay-ops: Also adding an invariant in playbooks: any automated renewal outreach needs at least two distinct signals (healthscore + telemetry OR last_successful_login within 90d) to fire.

kevin-plat: Ping me on the PR for the feature flagging docs; want to ensure toggles are visible in Console for quick rollback.

linda-cs: Thanks everyone. I'll close the pause when backfill completes and confirm with AEs. Followups in INC-8721 and CS-8730.
